notes.title: War Thunder Gets Chilly New Update
notes.notes:
World War II multiplayer plane-o-tank battler War Thunder [official site], which sadly bears no relation to Tropic Thunder, has received a big new update. Titled Cold Steel, it brings a veritable armament of changes and improvements, 20 new vehicles, and everything in between. Before we launch into the nitty-gritty, come watch the pretty trailer first.

… [visit site to read more]

notes.title: War Thunder - Update 1.51 'Cold Steel'
notes.notes:
[img]http://www.warthunder.com/upload/image/!%202015%20NEWS/June/major/news_1-51_com.jpg[/img]
[b][url=http://www.warthunder.com/upload/image/!%202015%20NEWS/June/major/1_51_1280x1024_logo_com.jpg]1280x1024[/url] | [url=http://www.warthunder.com/upload/image/!%202015%20NEWS/June/major/1_51_1920x1080_logo_com.jpg]1920x1080[/url][/b]

[h1][b]War Thunder proudly announces the 1.51 "Cold Steel" major update[/b][/h1]
Thanks to our loyal player base, we have reached major update time in War Thunder - 1.51 “Cold Steel”, now live on our servers. All around the world, our War Thunder players will be pleased to find 28 new vehicles, remodels, FM changes, a new game mode, bug fixes and a new map, Finland, which gives us our title for the update.

[quote][b]Be sure to check out the full [url=http://warthunder.com/en/game/changelog/current/466]update notes[/url] on our website![/b][/quote]

[url=http://warthunder.com/en/devblog/current/786]The Finland map[/url] gives us our first taste of a truly winter environment full of deep snow, icy water and frozen ground. Our players will be wanting to put on their winter clothing for this one, as it truly gives a feeling of the frozen north, never has “Winter is coming” meant so much to us here in War Thunder. Based upon a real location in Finland, we can now recreate the fierce fighting that took place in the unforgiving cold of the north. 

[url=http://www.warthunder.com/upload/image/!%202015%20NEWS/June/ColdSteel/Finland1.jpeg]
[img]http://www.warthunder.com/upload/image/!%202015%20NEWS/June/ColdSteel/Finland1M.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=http://www.warthunder.com/upload/image/!%202015%20NEWS/June/ColdSteel/Finland3.jpeg][img]http://www.warthunder.com/upload/image/!%202015%20NEWS/June/ColdSteel/Finland3M.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=http://www.warthunder.com/upload/image/!%202015%20NEWS/June/ColdSteel/Finland2.jpeg][img]http://www.warthunder.com/upload/image/!%202015%20NEWS/June/ColdSteel/Finland2M.jpg[/img][/url]

We are also introducing three top ranked ground vehicles into the game, one for each of the existing ground combat nations. For Germany, it is the unparalleled [url=http://warthunder.com/en/devblog/current/792]Leopard 1[/url], the Bundeswehr’s first post war independently designed tank, while the US will be sporting the [url=http://warthunder.com/en/devblog/current/794]M60 [/url]with its powerful 105 mm cannon. These main battle tanks will be able to field all-new shell types including HEATFS and HESH rounds, with the latter causing destruction through increased armour spalling. As a counter, our Soviet fans will receive the T-10M, a heavy tank that spent 40 years in Red Army service. Furthermore, Germany will receive its first multi turreted tank, the [url=http://warthunder.com/en/devblog/current/787]Neubaufahrzeug VI[/url], used in conflict in the Norwegian theatre. Of course, these won’t be the only vehicles introduced with this update, as we have a batch of premium and non-premium vehicles for you, which you can see in our [url=http://warthunder.com/en/game/changelog/current/466]full change log[/url].

[url=http://www.warthunder.com/upload/image/!%202015%20NEWS/June/ColdSteel/Leo1.jpg][img]http://www.warthunder.com/upload/image/!%202015%20NEWS/June/ColdSteel/Leo1m.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=http://www.warthunder.com/upload/image/!%202015%20NEWS/June/ColdSteel/M602.jpeg][img]http://www.warthunder.com/upload/image/!%202015%20NEWS/June/ColdSteel/M60m.jpg[/img][/url]<

[url=http://www.warthunder.com/upload/image/!%202015%20NEWS/June/ColdSteel/T10.jpeg][img]http://www.warthunder.com/upload/image/!%202015%20NEWS/June/ColdSteel/T10M.jpg[/img][/url]

Aircraft fans will not be disappointed with the additions across all the nations, from the hard hitting and beautiful [url=http://warthunder.com/en/devblog/current/798]MkIV Hurricane[/url] to the cannon equipped [url=http://warthunder.com/en/devblog/current/793]Helldiver[/url]. Our Japanese aircraft fans will be catered for with the [url=http://warthunder.com/en/devblog/current/793]J2M5[/url] high altitude interceptor being added to the available models, Germany will receive the IL-2 into its captured vehicle lineup and for our Soviet pilots, the addition of several premiums. Read more about the full aircraft release [url=http://warthunder.com/en/game/changelog/current/466]here[/url]. 

[url=http://www.warthunder.com/upload/image/!%202015%20NEWS/June/ColdSteel/HurrIV.jpeg][img]http://www.warthunder.com/upload/image/!%202015%20NEWS/June/ColdSteel/HurrIVm.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=http://www.warthunder.com/upload/image/!%202015%20NEWS/June/ColdSteel/Hell.jpeg][img]http://www.warthunder.com/upload/image/!%202015%20NEWS/June/ColdSteel/HellM.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=http://www.warthunder.com/upload/image/!%202015%20NEWS/June/ColdSteel/J2M5.jpeg][img]http://www.warthunder.com/upload/image/!%202015%20NEWS/June/ColdSteel/J2M.jpg[/img][/url]	

We are also introducing a fantastic new game mode that we have all been looking forward to. “[url=http://warthunder.com/en/devblog/current/788]Enduring Confrontation[/url]” will allow us all to experience the longevity of conflict, with infinite respawns and the chance to really test your mettle in battle. The battle will be long lasting and only the strongest will last to the bitter end. This mode is important to the game and we are looking to develop the mode further. Any feedback you can provide us on this mode will be extremely valuable.

Besides all the new features, many Flight and Damage Model improvements have been implemented including a multitude of game fixes that will ensure we all keep pushing the game to its fullest potential. We hope you will all continue to enjoy your experience with us and keep providing us with the very relevant feedback you have given us up till now!

[b]Be sure to check out Update 1.51 "Cold Steel" in game,
to see all the new content and improvements for yourself![/b]

[b][i]The War Thunder Team[/i][/b]

[url=http://forum.warthunder.com/index.php?showtopic=250751][b][u]Discuss it here![/u][/b][/url]

[url=http://www.warthunder.com/upload/image/!%202015%20NEWS/June/ColdSteel/Finland1.jpeg]
[img]http://www.warthunder.com/upload/image/!%202015%20NEWS/June/ColdSteel/Finland1M.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=http://www.warthunder.com/upload/image/!%202015%20NEWS/June/ColdSteel/Finland3.jpeg][img]http://www.warthunder.com/upload/image/!%202015%20NEWS/June/ColdSteel/Finland3M.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=http://www.warthunder.com/upload/image/!%202015%20NEWS/June/ColdSteel/Finland2.jpeg][img]http://www.warthunder.com/upload/image/!%202015%20NEWS/June/ColdSteel/Finland2M.jpg[/img][/url]

We are also introducing three top ranked ground vehicles into the game, one for each of the existing ground combat nations. For Germany, it is the unparalleled [url=http://warthunder.com/en/devblog/current/792]Leopard 1[/url], the Bundeswehr’s first post war independently designed tank, while the US will be sporting the [url=http://warthunder.com/en/devblog/current/794]M60 [/url]with its powerful 105 mm cannon. These main battle tanks will be able to field all-new shell types including HEATFS and HESH rounds, with the latter causing destruction through increased armour spalling. As a counter, our Soviet fans will receive the T-10M, a heavy tank that spent 40 years in Red Army service. Furthermore, Germany will receive its first multi turreted tank, the [url=http://warthunder.com/en/devblog/current/787]Neubaufahrzeug VI[/url], used in conflict in the Norwegian theatre. Of course, these won’t be the only vehicles introduced with this update, as we have a batch of premium and non-premium vehicles for you, which you can see in our [url=http://warthunder.com/en/game/changelog/current/466]full change log[/url].

[url=http://www.warthunder.com/upload/image/!%202015%20NEWS/June/ColdSteel/Leo1.jpg][img]http://www.warthunder.com/upload/image/!%202015%20NEWS/June/ColdSteel/Leo1m.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=http://www.warthunder.com/upload/image/!%202015%20NEWS/June/ColdSteel/M602.jpeg][img]http://www.warthunder.com/upload/image/!%202015%20NEWS/June/ColdSteel/M60m.jpg[/img][/url]<

[url=http://www.warthunder.com/upload/image/!%202015%20NEWS/June/ColdSteel/T10.jpeg][img]http://www.warthunder.com/upload/image/!%202015%20NEWS/June/ColdSteel/T10M.jpg[/img][/url]

Aircraft fans will not be disappointed with the additions across all the nations, from the hard hitting and beautiful [url=http://warthunder.com/en/devblog/current/798]MkIV Hurricane[/url] to the cannon equipped [url=http://warthunder.com/en/devblog/current/793]Helldiver[/url]. Our Japanese aircraft fans will be catered for with the [url=http://warthunder.com/en/devblog/current/793]J2M5[/url] high altitude interceptor being added to the available models, Germany will receive the IL-2 into its captured vehicle lineup and for our Soviet pilots, the addition of several premiums. Read more about the full aircraft release [url=http://warthunder.com/en/game/changelog/current/466]here[/url]. 

[url=http://www.warthunder.com/upload/image/!%202015%20NEWS/June/ColdSteel/HurrIV.jpeg][img]http://www.warthunder.com/upload/image/!%202015%20NEWS/June/ColdSteel/HurrIVm.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=http://www.warthunder.com/upload/image/!%202015%20NEWS/June/ColdSteel/Hell.jpeg][img]http://www.warthunder.com/upload/image/!%202015%20NEWS/June/ColdSteel/HellM.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=http://www.warthunder.com/upload/image/!%202015%20NEWS/June/ColdSteel/J2M5.jpeg][img]http://www.warthunder.com/upload/image/!%202015%20NEWS/June/ColdSteel/J2M.jpg[/img][/url]	

We are also introducing a fantastic new game mode that we have all been looking forward to. “[url=http://warthunder.com/en/devblog/current/788]Enduring Confrontation[/url]” will allow us all to experience the longevity of conflict, with infinite respawns and the chance to really test your mettle in battle. The battle will be long lasting and only the strongest will last to the bitter end. This mode is important to the game and we are looking to develop the mode further. Any feedback you can provide us on this mode will be extremely valuable.

Besides all the new features, many Flight and Damage Model improvements have been implemented including a multitude of game fixes that will ensure we all keep pushing the game to its fullest potential. We hope you will all continue to enjoy your experience with us and keep providing us with the very relevant feedback you have given us up till now!

[b]Be sure to check out Update 1.51 "Cold Steel" in game,
to see all the new content and improvements for yourself![/b]

[b][i]The War Thunder Team[/i][/b]

[url=http://forum.warthunder.com/index.php?showtopic=250751][b][u]Discuss it here![/u][/b][/url]

notes.title: Server Update 07.05.2015
notes.notes:
[img]https://fbcdn-sphotos-e-a.akamaihd.net/hphotos-ak-xat1/v/t1.0-9/s720x720/11203119_953655838001713_5170621484765664494_n.jpg?oh=11927a0d562869c38b96eb16cc028d9f&oe=55C44864&__gda__=1439135256_d72fd2f426181ff679a9e36d77c0dffe[/img]

[h1][b]Server Update 07.05.2015[/b][/h1]
 
[b]The following changes are a server update that will be implemented on the game servers within 24 hours. During this time, bug reports regarding specifics mentioned here and their effect in a battle will not be considered as a bug and as such will not be taken into consideration.[/b][list]
[*]The maximum fire rate of the M7 gun (M10 GMC) has been decreased from 12 to 9.6 shots per minute.
[*]The maximum fire rate of the M1 gun (M18 GMC) has been decreased from 12 to 9.9 shots per minute.
[*]The M26e1’s coaxial machine gun type has been fixed. The М1918А4 has changed to high-calibre M2HB, and the ammo load has decreased from 3000 to 1000.
[*]The maximum fire rate of the D-49 gun (Su-122-54 SPG) has been increased from 4.2 to 4.86 shots per minute.
[*]The fire rates of the M1 and M7 guns (М4А1/А2/А3 76 and М6А1 tanks) have been decreased from 12 to 10.2 shots per minute.
[*]The PzGr 39 105 mm shell’s penetration values have been fixed.
[*]The effectiveness of sloped armour, when hit by APCR rounds at 55-60 degree angles, has increased[/list]
[b]Note: This server update applies to all platforms unless specifically highlighted.[/b]

notes.title: War Thunder Update 1.70.1945 - Weapons of Victory
notes.notes:
[img]http://warthunder.com/upload/image/!%202015%20NEWS/April/1.49/1280.jpg[/img]
Weapons of Victory wallpaper: [url=http://www.warthunder.com/upload/image/!%202015%20NEWS/April/1.49/1280.jpg]1280x1024[/url] [url=http://www.warthunder.com/upload/image/!%202015%20NEWS/April/1.49/1920.jpg]1920x1080[/url]

[h1]Update 1.70.1945 - Weapons of Victory[/h1]
https://youtu.be/esTk6SocFAg
[h1][b]Gaijin Entertainment wishes to announce major Update 1.70.1945
"Weapons of Victory" for War Thunder![/b][/h1]
Well, thanks to our fantastic community, here we are again with another jaw dropping update for War Thunder. "Weapons of Victory" - Update 1.70.1945 - is now live on our servers. War Thunder players worldwide have access to 40 new vehicles and 3 new maps thematically tied to the final stages of WWII plus a host of other changes that will keep us all interested.

[quote]Be sure to check out the [url=http://www.warthunder.com/en/game/changelog/current/439]full update notes[/url] on our website![/quote]

The Normandy map provides a deadly mix of ambush points and terrain and is a true ‘battle for the hedgerows’ homage to the Allied push to retake northern France in June 1944. Hürtgen Forest details the challenging terrain of Western Germany faced by US Army in the longest battle in its history. War Thunder’s Berlin map will take armoured combat to the hard fought streets around the Reichstag.

[url=http://warthunder.com/en/game/changelog/current/439][b][u]Read the List of changes in War Thunder 1.70.1945 here![/u][/b][/url]

notes.title: Mouse Aim 2.0: New WIP-Update, many improvements for Arcade!
notes.notes:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NmdLdb5kybo
[h1][b]Dear Players![/b][/h1]
Over the past days we've been trying the new Mouse Aim mechanics on the Work-In-Progress Client, and many players participated in testing and provided valuable feedback for us. Our developers have worked hard to analyze the feedback and further improve the feeling of Mouse Aim, and again, a new version of Mouse Aim 2.0 is available on WIP now (10.04.2015). Please, download it now and try it - as we need your feedback once more!
 
Most of the changes in this update are targeted at Mouse Aim performance in Arcade Battles, as the great majority of feedback about the behavior in Realistic Battles has been positive. But even there, we've implemented some further improvements you should try out and voice your opinion on!

[b][u]Changes include:[/u][/b][list]
[*]The nose of aircraft will no longer 'drop' on horizontal maneuvers; the aircraft will maintain a level plane on all altitudes (esp. AB)
[*]The aircraft's reaction has been improved: The instructor will now act switfly to mouse input (esp. AB)
[*]Rolling the aircraft with keyboard (A, D keys) will not limit Mouse input, which was especially noticeable on certain fast-rolling aircraft (esp. AB)
[*]and more tweaks and improvements![/list]
To try out Mouse Aim 2.0, just check the [url=http://forum.warthunder.com/index.php?/topic/209900-information-about-the-work-in-progress-client/]WIP-Checkbox[/url] in the launcher and start testing! We will continue to use the two topics we've created for your feedback, one for [url=https://forum.warthunder.com/index.php?/topic/229912-new-mouseaim-feedback-arcade-battles/][b]Arcade Battles[/b][/url] and one for [url=http://forum.warthunder.com/index.php?/topic/229909-new-mouseaim-feedback-realistic-battles/][b]Realistic Battles.[/b][/url] However, we've reset the poll, so it better reflects the opinion on the current iteration.
 
Thanks to all of you who are participating in the testing!

notes.title: [In Development] Game mode changes in Realistic and Simulator
notes.notes:
[img]http://warthunder.ru/upload/image/Dev%20Blog/ss+(2015-02-26+at+06_20_17)(1).jpg[/img]
War Thunder game modes are constantly evolving, while offering players an interesting mix of missions, maps, vehicles and diversity of controls options. Today we going to discuss the changes that will occur in the Simulator and Realistic modes. The combined battle bonus challenges, which were popular with the players, will now be available to you at any time. In realistic ground forces battles we will turn off markers that display opposing players, and in simulator air battles we will disable the interface, and will also introduce a daily nation change. But first things first!

[h1][b]Simulator Battles​[/b][/h1]
The first change you will notice will be the moving of the SB mode option. Now they will be available in a new section "Simulator Battles", which will be near the "Events" and will hold regular air and ground forces simulator battles, as well as an increased amount of simultaneously run special events and you will be able to choose freely between modes and settings that are of interest to you. Beyond that, we will also be implementing a number changes in the modes themselves:

[b]Aviation​[/b]
In simulator air battles we will enable an automatic system that switches nations and locations participating in battle, this will be enabled at 11:00 GMT.

A daily change of nations, as well as a shift of nations that are available for certain days of the week, will allow players to test their skills against opponents in various war theatres. Below we provide an example of how the system may work (the final version may differ from one shown):
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=399403078
Furthermore, you will need to learn the position of instruments in the cockpits of your aircraft, as we plan to disable the HUD indicators for aircraft with a modelled cockpit. Now a player has to keep track of his speed, altitude, engine temperature, fuel amount and ammunition count (if the aircraft is equipped with the necessary indicator) himself. Do not forget, it is now possible to turn on the lights in the cockpit (in aircraft fitted with them). Pilots of aircraft without modelled cockpit at the moment, will be able to keep track of important indicators on the interface, just as before.

[b]Ground Forces[/b]
The test of absolute simulator battles has created a huge interest among the War Thunder players - no markers and different combinations of available vehicles and locations allowed players to try themselves in the most difficult conditions. Many of you have asked for implementation of it on a regular basis, and that is exactly what we are doing, as this mode will now replace the standard simulator battles. You will have several options of switchable scenarios for the mode with different vehicle sets available in them. Choose the right option for you! Do not forget that markers in this mode are off - use binoculars to determine whether it’s the enemy or an ally on the horizon.
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=399403110
[h1][b]Ground Forces RB [/b][/h1]
We are making changes in realistic ground forces battles as well. It will offer you the usual battles, but the markers on opponents will be disabled. You'll still be able to see markers over your allies in this mode, and the usual mechanics of the RB mode will apply.

[h1][b]Events​[/b][/h1]
We will increase the number of simultaneously active events for all three modes. SB events will be located in the SB section and other events will be located in the Events tab, which is already familiar to you.

The changes are planned to be implemented within the next week. Please leave your feedback on our forums!
 
[url=http://forum.warthunder.com/index.php?showtopic=219525]Discuss it here![/url]

notes.title: War Thunder 1.47 update brings out the Big Guns
notes.notes:
Greetings Friends. It Seems Like This Is A News Post About War Thunder's New Update.

Sorry, you caught me trying to impersonate the narrator of free-to-play war-'em-up War Thunder's 1.47 update; a man who talks like every word in a sentence starts with a capital letter. It's pretty remarkable:

The update is called "Big Guns," and so should probably feature some Big Guns. Let's see... contrails? No. Animated cockpit canopy? That's not it. New aircraft and ground vehicles—completing the US vehicle line, and this finishing the Steel Generals beta phase? Yeah, that's probably it.

As for the planes, the B-29 Superfortress makes its debut, as does a 1941 version of the USSR's famous IL-2.

Also in this update, terrain deformation means vehicles will handle differently depending on their surface. And there's a plethora of new visual effects. The update is now live, and you can see its full list of features over at the official War Thunder site.

notes.title: [In Development] Changes in arcade ground forces mechanics
notes.notes:
Bombers, for tankers, often appear as a sudden surprise, frequently there is not enough time to react. This particularly affects arcade battles where the mechanics of this mode are such that enemy aircraft will only appear when players select the air support event via the HUD. Now bomb ordnance on aircraft in ground forces arcade battles will have a delay of 10 seconds set by default. This means that even when a bomb has struck the ground it will explode only after 10 seconds have passed from when it was released, ground vehicles will now have time to avoid the explosion. In addition, bombs that are close to player will have an icon above them, warning those in the area about the danger.
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=394976663
The timer will start after the bomb is released from the aircraft, but the bomb will not explode before it touches the ground. So, if 10 seconds have already passed after the bomb was released and it touches the ground, it will explode immediately.

We are also giving players an opportunity to use the old artillery strike system for arcade battles. Now you will be able to switch between the current one (map based) and the view of your artillery target, which raises the camera over your vehicle for a better choice of artillery strike position. Notice that the height of the camera elevation above the ground is reduced in comparison to the previous implementation of the feature, thus it will provide less of a tactical advantage while using it.
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=394976808
In simulator and realistic battle modes you will only be able to use the map based artillery strike system.

We are looking forward to your feedback on the forum!
 
[url=http://forum.warthunder.com/index.php?showtopic=216780]Discuss it here![/url]

notes.title: [In Development] Ground Forces Map changes
notes.notes:
We continue to work on existing maps for ground forces in War Thunder. Our goal is to both improve their overall appearance, and to add various areas of interest - such as additional shelter or places with tactical advantage over enemy forces. We present to you a selection of changes in existing maps:

[h1]Kuban[/h1]
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=386555490
We have done massive work on the entire western part of Kuban. We have smoothed the general topography of the landscape, resulting in more fluent vehicle travel, as well as removed the hill in the northwest part of the map - now there will be a ravine that you can cross without having to detour instead.
 
We have also added a stone shelter on a hill overlooking the lake, which will allow tanks with high-profiles to fire at the enemy crossing the path and still to be partially protected from enemy attacks.
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=386555678
Among other things, we have marked rough slopes with rocks that will allow players to see a steep descent much earlier rather than when the player is too close to avoid the danger from it.
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=386555786

[h1]Karelia[/h1]
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=386555865
The mountain near the northern airfield has been modified to allow easier access to aircraft for landing. However the main focus of the map was to improve the ability to perform a greater variety of tactical maneuvers using ground vehicles. For this reason we have created a fork in the road from the eastern area of spawn, we have also added a convenient pathway to the central elevation from the north-western spawn point.
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=386555950

[h1]Mozdok[/h1]
With Mozdok we are working to change the topography of the map in order to achieve a better balance for a variety of the game modes. To do this, we have altered the terrain of western and central capture points used in Arcade mode, as well as the southern capture point, which is used in Realistic battles. The changes are designed to equalize the chances of victory for both teams.
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=386556055

[h1]Eastern Europe[/h1]
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=386556130
We have made a lot of different changes for the Eastern Europe map. We redesigned many areas of the city, added many unique areas and squares, as well as improved performance on the map.
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=386556209
We will continue to improve our maps based on your valid feedback on the forums, so please continue to log your suggestions and we will see you in battle!

[url=http://forum.warthunder.com/index.php?/topic/212689-in-development-ground-forces-map-changes/][Discuss it here![/url]

[b][i]The War Thunder Team[/i][/b]

notes.title: Arcade battles BR changes
notes.notes:
[h1]Pilots, we have an important announcement for you![/h1]

Pilots, we have an important announcement for you!

In arcade air battles, BR is calculated as an average value of the BR from the top-3 aircraft. So that when a player gets a new vehicle - he won’t face opponents with a much stronger line-up. But in order to avoid exploiting of this feature we have added certain restrictions. 
 
The general formula to calculate the overall BR is:
Overall BR = [b](A+B+C)/2/2[/b]

where A is the highest aircraft (according to BR) in a player's lineup, and B and C are the aircraft with the highest BR following A.
 
In the old calculation, when the BR of the highest aircraft (A) and the two following ones (B & C) was greater than 0.6, an alternative formula was being applied that still took B and C in consideration when calculating overall BR, but with a much lower influence. You can see the old calculation [url=http://forum.warthunder.com/index.php?/topic/125109-battle-rating-for-arcade-matchmaking-explained-139/]here[/url], this part is explained at the bottom.

[b]With our new calculation, a player who has a high-ranked top aircraft (A), but uses other aircraft (potential B & C) that all have a BR with more than 0.6 difference, they will not be taken into account while the overall BR is calculated. Thus, in this case, the BR of A will be taken as overall BR.[/b]

The changes are already in effect. Make sure to leave your feedback on the forums!
 
The War Thunder Team

notes.title: Arcade battles BR changes
notes.notes:
[h1]Pilots, we have an important announcement for you![/h1]

Pilots, we have an important announcement for you!

In arcade air battles, BR is calculated as an average value of the BR from the top-3 aircraft. So that when a player gets a new vehicle - he won’t face opponents with a much stronger line-up. But in order to avoid exploiting of this feature we have added certain restrictions. 
 
The general formula to calculate the overall BR is:
Overall BR = [b](A+B+C)/2/2[/b]

where A is the highest aircraft (according to BR) in a player's lineup, and B and C are the aircraft with the highest BR following A.
 
In the old calculation, when the BR of the highest aircraft (A) and the two following ones (B & C) was greater than 0.6, an alternative formula was being applied that still took B and C in consideration when calculating overall BR, but with a much lower influence. You can see the old calculation [url=http://forum.warthunder.com/index.php?/topic/125109-battle-rating-for-arcade-matchmaking-explained-139/]here[/url], this part is explained at the bottom.

[b]With our new calculation, a player who has a high-ranked top aircraft (A), but uses other aircraft (potential B & C) that all have a BR with more than 0.6 difference, they will not be taken into account while the overall BR is calculated. Thus, in this case, the BR of A will be taken as overall BR.[/b]

The changes are already in effect. Make sure to leave your feedback on the forums!
 
The War Thunder Team

notes.title: Update 09.01.2015 - Server Update on 1.45.10.91
notes.notes:
[b]1.45.10.91[/b] is a server update that will be implemented on the game servers within 24 hours. During this time, bug reports regarding specifics mentioned here and their effect in a battle will not be considered as a bug in this period and as such will not be taken into consideration.
[list]
[*]Correct ammo allocation within modules for the following vehicles has been implemented: Т-35, Tiger II 10.5cm, Tiger II P/H, Tiger I, M103, M26.
[*]Moment of mass has been tuned for the following vehicles: М2А4 , М3, М3А1, М5А1.
[*]Maximum fire rate for 75mm KwK42 cannon has been increased from 6,96 to 7,2 shots per minute.
[*]Maximum fire rate for 75mm KwK44 cannon has been increased from 6,96 to 9 shots per minute
[*]Maximum fire rate for 76mm cannons M1 and M7 has been increased from 7,2 to 12 shots per minute
[*]Armour penetration for KwK42/44 APCR shells has been fixed. It has been increased for all distances, Penetration effect reduction now corresponds with the speed reduction of the shells.
[*]Armour penetration for KwK36 APCR shells has been fixed. it has been increased for the distance of 1500m.
[*]Armour penetration for  M1/M7 cannons M93 shells has been fixed. It has been increased for all distances, Penetration effect reduction now corresponds with the speed reduction of the shells.
[*]Armour penetration for 85mm BR-365P APCR shell has been increased for the distances up to 500m.
[*]APCR shell performance has been fixed for different striking angles. Ricochet chance has been reduced. Critical angle where ricochet is 100% is 18 degrees. With a striking angle of more than 24 degrees there is no ricochet.
[*]Ricochet chances for armour piercing shells for all striking angles have been reduced.
[*]Behind armor effect for M62 76mm shells has been fixed (increased)
[*]Damaging effect of the armour fragmentation of the U.S. 75mm and 76mm AP shells has been increased. Now it is similar to that effect of the similar AP shells of the other nations.
[*]Armour penetration of the PzGr H. 30mm shell for MK103 cannon has been fixed.Penetration and damaging effects are now the same as for Kugelblitz.
[/list]
[b]Note all changes apply to all platforms unless stated in the changelog![/b]

notes.title: Update 22.12.2014 - Server Update on 1.45.7.56
notes.notes:
1.45.7.76 is a server update which means that it will be applied on the game servers over a period of 24 hours. During this time, bug reports regarding specifics mentioned here and their effect in a battle will not be considered as a bug in this period and as such will not be taken into consideration.
[list]
[*]Increased survivability for all crew members in all ground vehicles against fragmentation damage
[*]Damage effect of secondary fragmentation cones for all shells has been increased (spread angle and damage of the fragments themselves)
[*]After penetration effect for HEAT (hollow charge) shells have been increased (damage caused by the HEAT’s jet and damage of the resulting secondary fragments have been increased)
[*]Centre of gravity position for all M4 Sherman tanks has been fixed. Because of this issue, the vehicle was slightly tail heavy  and the angle of the frontal armour to the horizon was too high.
[*]105mm M1 HE shell damage has been fixed. Armour penetration has been decreased from 35mm to 28mm. Radius of possibility to penetrate armour of such thickness has been decreased from 0.7 to 0.35 m
[*]Settings of the ammunition load for M4A3 (105) tank damage have been fixed. By error they were set for “wet load” with decreased chanced on explosion and fire of the ammunition
[*]Gear box of M24 tank has been fixed. Transmission ratio for low gear, high gear and reverse has been set up according to “TM  9-729 Light tank M24”
[*]For anti-air vehicle M15 machine-guns are now are set as coaxial weapons
[*]Error which led to it being impossible to apply skins on Mk I Grant has been fixed
[/list]
[b]Note all changes apply to all platforms unless stated in the changelog![/b]

[url=http://forum.warthunder.com/index.php?/topic/201112-update-22122014-server-update-on-145756/]Provide Feedback here[/url]

notes.title: Update 18.12.2014 (1.45.7.56)
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Error that led to wrong display of tank armouring while player is in the queue has been fixed
[*]Game mode selection has been improved
[*]Added difference in icons of queue depending on type of vehicle selected by player
[*]Error that led to wrong display of water and oil temperatures on the UI has been fixed.
[*]Issue that led to wrong fuel load being allocated after player selected the amount before the battle starts has been fixed.
[*]Render optimization.
[*]A few crash fixes (mostly on incorrect\broken data files)
[*]Small optimizations (mostly relevant for new tank maps)
[*]Error which led to ability to rotate the rest of the cannons in multi-cannon machines while one was completely disabled has been fixed.
[*]Anti-air and paired machine guns are now linked to a specific member of the crew (anti-air to commander or loader, paired to gunner) and if that crew member is disabled it will be impossible to use these machine guns.
[*]Error that led to it being impossible to replace disabled crew members on the M13/M16 has been fixed.
[*]Camera view “from commander” on M41 Walker Bulldog has been fixed.
[*]For ISU-152 and SU-152 the proportional load of the shells to each module has been set up and they now used together.
[*]Amount of respawns for Soviet reserve tanks T-26 and BT-5 has been limited to 2 until new reserve tanks for USA and Germany has been added.
[/list]

 
[url=http://forum.warthunder.com/index.php?/topic/199627-update-18122014-145756/]Discuss it Here[/url]

[b]1.43 update[/b] is now being installed on the servers and we suggest that you familiarize yourself with the changes that will occur to War Thunder in the new update. [b]Among the most important changes are:[/b]

[*]New ground vehicles: the T-35 multi-turreted tank, multiple AA vehicles and more
[*]New locations and maps: Mozdok, Norway, Poland and Tropical Island
[*]Arcade ground battles rework
[*]New hangar design
[*]New environment and weapon sounds
[*]Vehicle presets
[*]Racing mode
[*]New achievements and rewards

[/list]

notes.title: PS4 Update receives a warm welcome!
notes.notes:
[img]http://warthunder.com/upload/image/News/PS4/_1000_logo.png[/img]
[b]The latest PS4 Update receives a warm welcome from Players and Gaming Press alike![/b] - Recently, War Thunder has become one of the first cross platform games to be introduced on the PlayStation®4. This has instigated play between gamers on the PlayStation®4  and the already established PC/Mac  version of the game. It was done in conjunction with the US release of War Thunder on PS®4, which also brought Update 1.41 and Ground Forces along with other major improvements to the console.

Our latest phase in the development of War Thunder has been received well and has proved robust and stable. All our players are currently enjoying the experience of having all the platforms battling it out in the skies and on the ground of War Thunder.

We hope our player base continues to grow and we thank you all for continuing to support us as normal through this major update.

[b]Here are some of the first reviews received:[/b]

[i]Gamer Assault Weekly[/i]
[url=http://www.gamerassaultweekly.com/2014/06/04/war-thunder-review/]Score: 8/10[/url]

The team over at Gaijin is always looking for ways to improve the game on both the PC and PS4 platforms. In fact, flight stick compatibility for the PS4 will be added in the near future. If you are looking for a top quality competitive multiplayer game to play for your PS4, give War Thunder a download.


[i]PS Nation[/i]
[url=http://www.psnation.com/2014/06/03/review-war-thunder-ps4/]Score: 8/10[/url]

War Thunder has much to recommend it. There is no cost to play it. Free is almost always good. The game is easy to pick-up and plays really well. The MMO elements aren't difficult or too convoluted to get through.

[i]Gamesbeat[/i]

notes.title: Upcoming changes to Simulator battles
notes.notes:
[img]http://warthunder.com/upload/image/920_Comp_00001.jpg[/img]
[h1]Pilots and Tankers![/h1]

Soon, we plan to make some changes in Simulator Battle mode. After the release of Ground Forces, this mode has become much more popular, the majority of players preferring mixed plane and tank battles while “pure” air battles are less than 10%. Though the number of SB players has significantly increased, waiting time and Battle rating difference in one battle has also increased.

This is why air and tank battles in Simulator mode will be united in one mode soon. This will allow pilots to join the battles faster and will improve the in-game balance.

Those who prefer only air battles will be able to choose “Events” mode, where “Duels” will become available once again - fast 4 vs 4 Simulator Battles  without nation limits. Match-making will work in the same way as our usual battles in other modes. There will also be historical events for Simulator mode that will still be regularly available.

Finally, Squadron Battles - In Arcade and Realistic mode there are always dozens of Squadrons fighting each other, but the Simulator level of competition is pretty low - few Squadrons join this mode and play only a few battles daily! This is why we have decided to suspend Squadron Battles in Simulation mode beginning on the 16th of June, on this day we will summarize the results and the winners will get their rewards.. Virtual pilots can still fight each other creating a map with individual settings in Custom Battles.

[b]The War Thunder team[/b]

notes.title: Changes to Squadron Battles
notes.notes:
[img]http://warthunder.com/upload/image/News/1.41/news_1-41_rus_com.jpg[/img]

[h1]Dear players![/h1]

Today, May the 30th, Squadron battles ratings will be reset. This is due to the fact that a few months have passed since the introduction of the functionality, it has changed significantly, from today it will work in a new format .

Firstly, Squadron combat will now involve not only aircraft, but also ground vehicles. In the modes of realistic and simulator combat with no respawns, so commanders will have to carefully and strategically choose the selection of equipment before the fight .

Secondly, only vehicles of rank III and IV may be used in squadron battles. We believe that , on the one hand, this will provide the necessary variety of techniques, and on the other - will help maintain game balance.

Squadron battles will only be available at certain times:
 
[b]00:01 to 04:00 GMT[/b] and from [b]15:00 to 19:00 GMT[/b] on Weekdays (Mon - Fri)

[b]00:01 to 06:00 GMT[/b] and from [b]15:00 to 21:00 GMT[/b] at Weekends (Sat - Sun)

Before the ratings were reset, we have given the highest rated squadron rewards, nearly 100k Golden Eagles have been shared out.

Our future plans are to further improve Squadron combat, depending on your feedback. So stay tuned!

[i]The War Thunder Team[/i]

notes.title: Game Update 14.01.2014 (1.37.42.1)
Update 1.37
notes.notes:
The long expected Update - 1.37 - will bring several significant changes to the game, such as:

 

A completely different progression system. All vehicles are divided into 5 ranks instead of 20, to get a new aircraft a player will have to research a previous one, researching the desired vehicle has become faster.
 

New render with the support of DirectX 11, improving graphics quality and performance up to 25% (on some video cards).
 

Many of new planes have been added, such as the Soviet fighters the I-185 and the La-9, the American P-400. The German Bf 109 F-1 and Bf 109 F-2, The Hs. 129B-3 attacker with an incredible 75 mm cannon, the series of Japanese Ki-84 fighters and others.
 

New “Custom Battles”. Now the battles are hosted on a dedicated War Thunder server and not on the player’s side. This will provide ease of use and a high quality connection for online tournaments, clanmates and for all those who play custom battles.
 

The mission editor is now added to “test flight” mode and you can test any desired aircraft in different situations, choose the scenario of a battle, the weather and the number and power of your opponents.
 

More than 70 aircraft have their Flight and Damage models tuned to fully meet the historically accurate data. Please refer to our forums for the full list and current flight models state report.
 

8 new maps added for different modes
 

These and many other exciting changes await you in the War Thunder Update 1.37. Full list of changes
http://warthunder.com/en/game/changelog

http://www.youtube.com/watch?feature=player_embedded&v=QQneeJKvWYQ

notes.title: Developers' diaries: progression system (UPDATE)

Hello again, pilots!

The progression system that we presented in the previous issue of developers’ diaries has changed significantly. notes.title: Update 1.35
notes.notes:
Pilots, we present the War Thunder update 1.35.

War Thunder update 1.35 introduces a new gameplay element – Events mode. Events mode includes special battles with custom parameters. In Events mode, players can recreate historical battles, try new missions and maps, or use familiar maps with customized flight model settings. War Thunder pilots have the ability not only to choose which side of the conflict they are on and which aircraft to use in battle, but also to evaluate their opponent's strength – where, against whom, and in what mode they will fight.

Read the full changes Here!

http://warthunder.com/en/game/changelog/
